Proof in the paper: The peaks for NiCu0.33/C at 44.36 and 51.71° agree well with the simulated profiles for Ni3Cu alloy crystal and demonstrate the formation of NiCu0.33 alloy (Figure S5). The lattice spacings of 0.335 and 0.201 nm in the HR-TEM images of NiCu0.33/C correspond to the (2 2 0) plane of graphitic carbon and (1 1 1) plane of Ni3Cu alloy, respectively (Fig. 2).
